category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: The packet does not target sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling, oily or dandruff scalp; the supported production route is the ordinary balanced shampoo bucket.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: Strong: olefin sulfonate at position 2 is reinforced by sodium lauroyl sarcosinate and other surfactants; sulfate-free positioning does not make this chassis mild. Observed intensity: regular.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: normal — Strong cleansing, high conditioning and moderate weight fit normal hair that wants moisture/curl care. coarse — High moisture/curl conditioning supports coarse hair while the strong cleanser prevents a heavy-only profile. Conditional (not emitted): fine — High curl-care conditioning and butter/polymer routes can weigh fine hair down, even though strong cleansing gives reset capacity.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong: olefin sulfonate at position 2 is reinforced by sodium lauroyl sarcosinate and other surfactants; sulfate-free positioning does not make this chassis mild.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: High: early glycerin, glycol distearate, shea butter, sodium hyaluronate and two cationic polymer routes form a broad curl/moisture care system.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete INCI contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; salicylic acid alone is not enough under v1.4.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: General: dominant positioning is curl-method moisture, but curl and moisture are not v1.4 focus values. The formula strongly supports moisture/curl care without fitting a more specific v1.4 focus cleanly.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: there is no distinct v1.4 secondary focus with its own independent claim route; sulfate-free, silicone-free and curl-method language all support the same moisture/curl positioning.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the scalp is named only as the application area; the claims target curly hair moisture, not sensitive, itchy or uncomfortable scalp.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are standard wet-scalp application and rinse-out, with no treatment or reset cadence trigger.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: shea butter, glycol distearate and cationic guar/polyquaternium routes can leave curl-care residue, while the strong olefin-sulfonate/sarcosinate chassis and lack of silicone keep it below high.
